questions.stem_text: For 99% of human history, people have depended solely on _________ for their subsistence.
The Minoans inhabited the _________ island of Crete.
Among Inca royalty, what happened following the death of the king?

options.A: the king's body was mummified and treated as if it were alive
options.B: hundreds of the elite were sacrificed by ritual decapitation
options.C: the body was entombed with lavish burial goods within an enormous pyramid

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the king's body was mummified and treated as if it were alive

questions.stem_text:
In periods of great difficulty and stress, it appears that the Minoans __________ in order
to appease the gods.

options.B: burnt their own houses to the ground

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - sacrificed adults and occasionally children

questions.stem_text:
Up to 50,000 years ago, what was the relationship between anatomically modern humans and
us?

options.A: They looked and thought like us.
options.B: They looked like us but did not think like us.
options.C: They thought like us but did not look like us.
options.D: They did not look or think like us.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - They looked like us but did not think like us.
